questions.questionText: An electromagnetic wave of frequency $f = 5\text{ GHz}$ propagates in a medium with relative permittivity $\epsilon_r = 2$ and relative permeability $\mu_r = 2$. If the speed of light in the medium is $x \times 10^7\text{ m/s}$, the value of $x$ is:
questions.explanation: Given $f = 5\text{ GHz}$, $\epsilon_r = 2$, $\mu_r = 2$. Speed of wave in medium is $v = \frac{c}{\sqrt{\epsilon_r \mu_r}} = \frac{3 \times 10^8}{\sqrt{2 \times 2}} = \frac{3 \times 10^8}{2} = 1.5 \times 10^8\text{ m/s} = 15 \times 10^7\text{ m/s}$. Hence, $x = 15$.
